court: In the High Court of Madras†
advocates: For Respondent No. 1: Mr. S. Raja Standing Counsel
For Respondent No. 2: Mr. S.C. Herold Singh Standing Counsel
prayer: PRAYER: Petition filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, to initiate contempt proceedings against the contemnors/respondents and punish them for their willful disobedience of the order of this Court in WP(MD) No. 28433 of 2025, dated 13.10.2025.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

B. Pugalendhi, J.:— When this contempt petition is taken up for hearing the learned counsel for the respondents submit that the order of this Court dated 13.10.2025 passed in WP(MD) No. 28433 of 2025 has been complied with.

2. Recording the above submission, this contempt petition is closed.
